candidate.note: The measured tree was uncommitted. Reproduce the exact runtime using optimized-runtime.patch.txt on the baseline; verify Git blob hashes.

method: Seven fresh processes per variant/scenario; discarded fresh-process warmup; alternating AB/BA pairs; native host; serial campaigns; correctness checks in every sample.
projection: Captured numeric metrics, checks, scenario data and process timing are retained at full JSON precision. Private source-root paths and redundant raw stdout/stderr are omitted; candidate labels are normalized. No timings reconstructed from rounded tables.

harness.download: Remove only the .txt suffix before running with Bun.
harness.configurationOnlyAdaptation: Coordinator source roots are read from BUNQUEUE_BASELINE_ROOT and BUNQUEUE_CANDIDATE_ROOT. Workload, timing, integrity checks and aggregation are unchanged.

limitations: One native host; power/governor mode not recorded for this campaign; not a production capacity or tail-latency study.
TCP uses an in-memory broker and scalar commands, not durable or batched worker throughput.
Monitoring timings are event-free; callback equivalence is checked separately.
Single-queue control adds about 24ns; small TCP/disabled/prototype-control differences are inconclusive.
SQLite transaction grouping is rejected and excluded from delivered-performance results.
